title: Cone triangles in the localization of finite filtered complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $\mathcal C$ be the additive category of finite decreasingly filtered objects with filtration-preserving maps [def-sp-filtration], or its full additive subcategory specified by fixed integers $a\le b$ and the bounds $F^aX=X$, $F^{b+1}X=0$. Let $K^+(\mathcal C)$ be the category of bounded-below integer-indexed cochain complexes modulo filtration-preserving chain homotopies. A complex is graded acyclic if all its graded complexes [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] have zero cohomology [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $W$ consist of maps inducing quasi-isomorphisms on every graded complex. The category $K^+(\mathcal C)$ is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category], with shifts and cone triangles given by the cochain formulas in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and the direct-sum filtration on cones. For every full additive subcategory $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal C$, the category $K^+(\mathcal J)$ has the same cone triangulation and its inclusion into $K^+(\mathcal C)$ is exact. A map lies in $W$ if and only if its cone is graded acyclic. The localization $Q:K^+(\mathcal C)\to K^+(\mathcal C)[W^{-1}]$ is a triangulated category with distinguished triangles the triangles isomorphic to images of cone triangles, and $Q$ is exact. Localizations and morphisms are taken in a universe large enough to contain them.

proof.text: Use the existing additive structures of finite filtered objects from [def-trf-finite-filtered-localization]. Mathlib HomotopyCategory.plus.IsTriangulated restricts the standard homotopy triangulation [lem-trf-additive-homotopy-category-triangulated] to bounded-below complexes [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]. For a distinguished triangle T, take the underlying cochain representatives of its first two vertices. They are bounded below by plus_quotient_obj_iff. Fullness of HomotopyCategory.quotient supplies a cochain representative f of its first arrow. Compare T with mappingCone.triangleh f using isoTriangleOfIso₁₂ [lem-sf-triangle-morphism-iso], with identity isomorphisms on the first two vertices. Conversely, an isomorphism to this distinguished cone triangle makes the original triangle distinguished in the inherited full-subcategory triangulation.

For each full additive subcategory J, apply the same existing bounded-below homotopy triangulation. Its inclusion is additive. The Mathlib Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.IsTriangulated instance identifies the induced inclusion as exact; no filtered-injective or other special property of J is required.

For each p, compose the additive graded functor on bounded-below homotopy categories from [def-trf-finite-filtered-localization] with the inclusion into K(A). This is triangulated, so it sends T to a distinguished triangle. Rewrite graded quasi-isomorphisms as membership in the cone system of HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic using quasiIso_eq_trW_subcategoryAcyclic. The cone-system criterion trW_iff_of_distinguished [lem-trf-triangulated-subcategory-cone-system] identifies this with membership of the third vertex in that acyclic subcategory. Finally mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff identifies this with vanishing of every cohomology object. Quantify over p to obtain the asserted graded-acyclic criterion for any distinguished cone.

lean.statement: theorem filteredConeLocalization (B : Option (ℤ × ℤ)) (_hB : ∀ a b : ℤ, B = some (a, b) → a ≤ b) : IsTriangulated (FiniteFilteredHomotopyPlus A B false) ∧ (∀ T : Triangle (FiniteFilteredHomotopyPlus A B false), T ∈ distTriang (FiniteFilteredHomotopyPlus A B false) ↔ ∃ (X Y : CochainComplex.Plus (FiniteFilteredObjects A B false)) (f : X ⟶ Y), Nonempty ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.ι (FiniteFilteredObjects A B false)).mapTriangle.obj T ≅ CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangleh f.hom)) ∧ (∀ (J : ObjectProperty (FiniteFilteredObjects A B false)) [HasZeroObject J.FullSubcategory] [HasBinaryBiproducts J.FullSubcategory], IsTriangulated (HomotopyCategory.Plus J.FullSubcategory) ∧ J.ι.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.IsTriangulated) ∧ (∀ (T : Triangle (FiniteFilteredHomotopyPlus A B false)), T ∈ distTriang (FiniteFilteredHomotopyPlus A B false) → (finiteFilteredQuasiIso A B T.mor₁ ↔ ∀ p n : ℤ, IsZero ((HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n).obj (((filteredEvaluation A B false (some p)).mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj T.obj₃).obj)))) ∧ IsTriangulated (FiniteFilteredDerivedPlus A B) ∧ (finiteFilteredQh A B).IsTriangulated ∧ (∀ T : Triangle (FiniteFilteredDerivedPlus A B), T ∈ distTriang (FiniteFilteredDerivedPlus A B) ↔ ∃ S : Triangle (FiniteFilteredHomotopyPlus A B false), S ∈ distTriang (FiniteFilteredHomotopyPlus A B false) ∧ Nonempty (T ≅ (finiteFilteredQh A B).mapTriangle.obj S))
